Front: WGU C214: What must you adjust when calculating a semi-annual bond's Yield to Maturity (YTM) in Excel?
Back: Multiply N (years) by 2, divide annual coupon PMT by 2, compute =RATE(), and multiply the resulting semi-annual rate by 2. Full guide: https://signalacademic.com/courses/wgu-c213-c214-financial-management-accounting-guide

Front: WGU C214: What is the WACC formula and the #1 exam trap?
Back: WACC = (E/V)*Re + (D/V)*Rd*(1 - Tc). The #1 trap is forgetting the after-tax debt shield (1 - Tax Rate). Guide: https://signalacademic.com/courses/wgu-c213-c214-financial-management-accounting-guide

Front: WGU C207: When do you choose Chi-Square vs. Linear Regression vs. ANOVA?
Back: Chi-Square = two categorical variables; Linear Regression = continuous IV predicting continuous DV; ANOVA = comparing means across 3+ groups. Guide: https://signalacademic.com/courses/wgu-c207-data-driven-decision-making

Front: WGU C207: If p-value = 0.012 and alpha = 0.05, what is your statistical decision?
Back: Reject the null hypothesis (p < alpha) and translate the statistically significant relationship into a concrete business recommendation. Decode rubrics free: https://signalacademic.com/tools/rubric-checker

Front: WGU C213: Under the Indirect Cash Flow Method, how do increases in Accounts Receivable and Inventory affect Operating Cash Flow?
Back: Increases in current operating assets (AR, Inventory) are SUBTRACTED from Net Income; increases in current liabilities (AP) are ADDED. Guide: https://signalacademic.com/courses/wgu-c213-c214-financial-management-accounting-guide
